1.

God’s only Son, Thou woman’s Seed, Who on the cross for us didst suffer And bore sin’s burden; We praise Thee, who hast conquered the power of the grave, Laid death low, And reconciled us! And reconciled us!

2.

We sing of Thy precious blood, Which to every believer gives courage And a purged conscience. Through it we may draw near, Freely enter the sanctuary Unto God, the Holy One. Unto God, the Holy One.

3.

Thou hast declared to us Thy Father’s name; As sons we now draw near, With joy to praise Thee. Praise be to Thee in eternity! All glory, might, and majesty Are Thine forever. Are Thine forever.
